verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Python SDK, REST endpoints (cURL/Postman), a Transform MCP server and a no-code UI, but nothing shows an official Unstructured command-line tool. The only CLI mention is third-party tools such as the Codex CLI, which count as MCP clients rather than an Unstructured CLI. A data-processing platform could plausibly ship a CLI, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence means none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
